product_intent: A compact desktop device that enables manual indexing of an internal platform through external hand crank rotation with enclosed mechanical operation

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop indexing box.
The user should rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step.
The output should remain stationary between indexing events.
The mechanism should be enclosed inside a protective housing.
The product should be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation.
The number of indexed positions is not prescribed.

requirements.statement: The product shall enable a user to rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step

verification.observable: The internal indexing platform advances by one discrete step for each complete rotation of the external hand crank
verification.condition: External hand crank is rotated by user

requirements.statement: The product shall maintain an output in a stationary state between indexing events

verification.observable: The internal indexing platform remains stationary when not being indexed
verification.condition: No rotation of external hand crank is occurring

requirements.statement: The product shall enclose the indexing mechanism inside a protective housing

verification.observable: All internal mechanical components are enclosed within a housing structure

requirements.statement: The product shall be mechanically plausible

verification.observable: All mechanical components can function together without interference or impossibility
verification.condition: Product design is analyzed for mechanical compatibility

requirements.statement: The product shall be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly of the product can be completed without requiring special tools or excessive effort

requirements.statement: The product shall be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Product design can be manufactured using standard manufacturing techniques and materials
verification.condition: Product design is analyzed for manufacturability

requirements.statement: The product shall be suitable for repeated manual operation

requirements.statement: The product shall support manual operation only
